source: NASA OSDR Environmental Data App (EDA) API

units.co2ppm: ppm (as reported by EDA; unit inferred from values)
units.co2mmHg: mmHg, converted from ppm assuming 760 mmHg cabin pressure

notes: EDA timestamps for RR-9 run 2018-08-14 to 2018-09-18, although SpaceX-12 launched in August 2017. The app replays this data on its own mission clock, so absolute dates are not used.
